newsitem.title: USA: Delta seeks Cairo code-share with Swissair.
newsitem.headline: Delta seeks Cairo code-share with Swissair.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said Tuesday it has filed an application with the U.S. Department of Transportation seeking authority to operate code-share flights with Swissair to Cairo.

The air carrier said that, pending government approvals, the carriers propose starting service October 26. Its application seeks approval to code-share six times a week from Zurich to Cairo on Swissair A-310 aircraft.

Delta said the DOT filing comes as a result of the recent agreement between the U.S. and Egypt to expand air service between the two countries. Its Atlantic Excellence partner Swissair now offers service between Zurich and Cairo.
